name: Taste of the Sea
source:
You're tired. You're hungry. You miss your pet fish.

You’re not okay, but you don’t tell anyone. Through small, ordinary choices like whether to call your mom or eat another pack of instant noodles...

You step into the quiet life of a college student struggling with loneliness and burnout until you meet your beloved seafood.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807440/Taste_of_the_Sea/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你累了。你饿了。你想念你的宠物鱼。

你不好，但你不告诉任何人。通过一些小小的、普通的选择，比如是否给妈妈打电话或者再吃一包方便面……

你踏入了一个与孤独和倦怠作斗争的大学生的安静生活，直到你遇到了你心爱的海鲜。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3807440/Taste_of_the_Sea/]Steam[/url]]
